//: Version-controlled Firestore indexes for the named database. No composite indexes are needed: every query uses one sort field or equality filters only (checked Nov 2026). fieldOverrides hold TTL policies: documents are deleted after their expireAt passes (bot_updates_seen: Telegram message dedup, 3 days; bot_errors: the bot's failure log, 30 days). Deployed by the manual 'Deploy Firestore rules' workflow, without --force so an index made in the console is never deleted.
